BiblicalUsage: Shobab means backsliding, apostate, the heart that has turned away, and Jeremiah uses it for Israel herself. Turn, O backsliding children, the Lord says, for I am married unto you, and I will heal your backslidings. Isaiah hears the same charge, a people going on frowardly in the way of their own heart, and Jeremiah calls them lost sheep turned away on the mountains.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe backsliding is a marriage word before it is a moral one. God calls His people backsliding children because He is married to them, and I hold that His offer to heal is still open to every wanderer.
